prompts: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: portrait character poster for a Japanese language learning visual novel. Waist-up portrait, centered, graceful expressive face, detailed hand-drawn anime linework and cel shading, softly painted background, warm peach and sage colors. Vertical 2:3 framing. No text, no lettering, no watermark. Entirely illustrated anime, never photorealistic.
